title_zh: 约定住院朋友希望的陪伴方式

scenario.label_zh: 约定住院朋友希望的陪伴方式
scenario.goal_zh: 询问朋友是否希望有人陪伴，并约定简短探视而不追问病情

context_zh: 虚构医院探视前的电话：朋友讨论希望怎样获得陪伴，不涉及医疗建议。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Would you like a companion for your first afternoon back on the ward, or would you rather rest?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Company would be nice. I just don't want to spend the whole visit explaining my condition.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: I understand. I can bring a book, and we can talk about something else or simply sit together.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Thank you. People mean to show compassion, but answering the same questions is exhausting.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: I'll check with you before I come, as a courtesy, and keep the visit short.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Please do. Half an hour of ordinary conversation sounds lovely.
